title: The Loose Cipher
author: Emrys Halloran
blurb: Lena Thackeray, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
